scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cipher-party/game-core run build && pnpm --filter @cipher-party/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @cipher-party/web run build && pnpm --filter @cipher-party/worker run build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n worker,web "pnpm --filter @cipher-party/worker run dev" "pnpm --filter @cipher-party/web run dev"
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present run test && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
